resolved_external_species_level_targets.Ampelopsis glandulosa var. hancei: A. glandulosa source: functional specialization on short-tongued scoliid wasps and solitary bees; target variety/Izu population not directly measured
resolved_external_species_level_targets.Calystegia soldanella: self-incompatible and pollinator-dependent broad bee system in Japanese populations; not exclusive Bombus dependence
resolved_external_species_level_targets.Lonicera japonica: mixed effective diurnal bee and nocturnal hawkmoth system
resolved_external_species_level_targets.Vitex rotundifolia: multiple hymenopteran pollinators with Megachile kobensis dominant/well matched in coastal Japan

partial_targets.Farfugium japonicum: broad bee/fly/syrphid/butterfly pollination context exists, but exact target-population effectiveness dependence is not measured
partial_targets.Glehnia littoralis: direct diverse-insect entomophily study exists from China, but Japanese/Izu dependency transfer is unresolved
partial_targets.Lysimachia mauritiana: reproductive response to long-tongued-pollinator gradient resolved, exclusive dependency unresolved
partial_targets.Melanthera prostrata: source-observed functional pollinator interactions, independent effectiveness dependency unresolved
partial_targets.Oxalis corniculata var. trichocaulon: species-level breeding system is strongly population/morph dependent; exact Izu target state unresolved

why_blocked: The source-defined dominant pollen-success target set is dominated by externally documented non-Bombus, mixed-guild, broad-insect or population-variable pollination systems. No target has a source-resolved high-dependency Bombus state measured in the exact 2024 Izu populations. A dependency-by-FDQ slope comparison would therefore lack the high-dependency end of the predictor gradient and would be selection-conditioned on dominant surviving coastal plants.
what_is_allowed_now: report that realized breadth and tube length do not robustly moderate the FDQ slope
use resolved/partial external pollination evidence to characterize the target universe and its survivorship bias
treat 2017 reproductive sensitivity/resilience/counterresponse as separate validation modes
what_is_not_allowed: code legacy floral-form or family labels as effective dependency
interpret realized interaction breadth as effective pollinator dependence
fit a binary specialist/generalist interaction using the 10 targets as if both ends of the dependency gradient were source-resolved
interpret unstable proxy moderation as evidence that dependency does not matter
treat external species-level pollination studies as if they were measurements from the exact 2024 Izu populations
next_decisive_evidence: Add source-resolved high-dependency lineages or directly measure effective-pollinator dependence in the same Izu populations, while keeping establishment failure/hybrid replacement/interaction rewiring as outcomes rather than excluding them from the sampling frame.
claim_boundary: This readiness audit diagnoses predictor support and survivorship conditioning. It is not a test of the biological dependency hypothesis itself.
